title: Kummer regular-immersion fundamental classes and their operations
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, $n\geq1$, and $\Lambda_n=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$. For a regular closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ of Noetherian schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible, locally of codimension $c\geq0$, use ordinary small-etale derived categories, roots-of-unity twists and the compact-support right adjoints [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist], [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. Regular means that the ideal is locally generated by a regular sequence [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. There is a canonical supported fundamental class, equivalently a morphism
$$\eta_{i,n}:\Lambda_{n,Z}\longrightarrow i_n^!\Lambda_{n,X}(c)[2c].$$
On an affine chart with regular generators $t_1,\ldots,t_c$, put $Z_k=V(t_1,\ldots,t_k)$ ($Z_0=X$, $Z_c=Z$); the image of $t_k$ on $Z_{k-1}$ cuts out the effective Cartier divisor $Z_k\subset Z_{k-1}$. On this chart $\eta_{i,n}$ is the composite, under the composition rule below, of the $Ri_*\dashv i^!$ transposes of the supported Cartier Kummer maps $c_{Z_k,\Lambda_n}:R(i_k)_*\Lambda_{n,Z_k}\to\Lambda_{n,Z_{k-1}}(1)[2]$ of [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer] for $i_k:Z_k\hookrightarrow Z_{k-1}$. In particular, for $c=1$ the class of an effective Cartier divisor $D$ is the transpose of $c_{D,\Lambda_n}$, whose composite with the unit $\Lambda_{n,X}\to Ri_*\Lambda_{n,D}$ is $+c_1(\mathcal O_X(D))$; this fixes the Kummer sign. This formula is independent of the regular generators and of their order, and determines the global class. For $c=0$ it is the canonical open-and-closed restriction map, with the identity immersion giving $1$.

Under exceptional transitivity and addition of twist-shifts these classes compose: for regular closed immersions $Z\xrightarrow iY\xrightarrow jX$, $\eta_{ji,n}=i_n^!(\eta_{j,n})(c_i)[2c_i]\circ\eta_{i,n}$. They commute with flat base change of pairs, with open restriction, and with localization and strict localization via the canonical continuity identifications of supported etale cohomology. For every $N\geq n$, reduction $\Lambda_N\to\Lambda_n$ carries the supported class $\eta_{i,N}$ to $\eta_{i,n}$. The Tate-line comparison for this reduction is induced by $u\mapsto u^{\ell^{N-n}}$ on roots of unity, with dual tensor comparisons for negative twists.

source.place: Expose XVI, section 2.1 (supported Kummer first Chern class), Definition 2.3.1 and Theorem 2.3.2 (regular-immersion class and composition), Proposition 2.2.3.1 (base change preserving conormal data), section 3.2 before Definition 3.2.2 (local and strict-local restriction), coefficient square in Proposition 3.3.1 and compatible cocycles in Proposition 3.3.2. Continuity is the supported version of Stacks Tag 03Q6 (etale-cohomology.tex, lemma-directed-colimit-cohomology); only affine ind-etale localizations of Noetherian pairs are asserted here.

proof.text: For $c>0$ the conormal $N=I/I^2$ is a rank-$c$ vector bundle by [lem-per-regular-flag-blowup-geometry] (its assertion about a single regular immersion). Define $\eta_{i,n}$ as the adjoint of the supported class $\gamma_{i,N}$ of [lem-per-modified-blowup-generalized-class]. The supported-Hom identification [lem-amb-closed-support-hom] and the right adjoint [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint] identify $H_Z^{2c}(X,\Lambda_n(c))$ with the required morphism set. This gives a global construction, not a gluing of unspecified derived morphisms. For $c=0$ the ideal is zero near $Z$, so $Z$ is open and closed and the class is the adjoint of the evident restriction/projection on the corresponding summand.

For an effective Cartier divisor $D$, its conormal is the restriction of $I=\mathcal I_D$. The modified blowup is $X$, $\mathcal O(1)=I$, and $Q_I=-1$. Thus $\gamma_{i,I}=-e_D(I,1)=e_D(\mathcal O_X(D),1)$ by [lem-per-modified-blowup-generalized-class, lem-per-noetherian-supported-product-calculus]. The latter is exactly the class of $c_{D,\Lambda_n}$ of [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer]. Forgetting the support gives $+c_1(\mathcal O_X(D))$. This checks the sign before any composition argument.

We prove composition for $Z\xrightarrow iY\xrightarrow jX$, of codimensions $m,n$. Products below are the nested supported products of [lem-per-noetherian-supported-product-calculus]. By its supported-Hom clause and the pasted adjunctions of [lem-cat-right-adjoint-composition], the desired equation is $\gamma_{ji}=\gamma_i\cdot\gamma_j$. If $m=0$ or $n=0$, it is restriction followed by the given class, so follows from the definition. Suppose $m,n>0$. First prove the case $n=1$; no composition theorem is assumed in doing so.

Assume $n=1$. Blow up $Z$ in $X$. In the notation of [lem-per-regular-flag-blowup-geometry], $P=P(N_{X/Z})$, $\widetilde Y=\operatorname{Bl}_Z Y$, $P'=P(N_{Y/Z})$, and $\pi^*I=\mathcal I_P\otimes\mathcal I_{\widetilde Y}$ as trivialized lines off the inverse image of $Y$. Put $F=N_{Y/Z}$ (rank $m$), $K=i^*N_{X/Y}$ (rank one), $H=N_{X/Z}$, and $\xi=c_1(\mathcal O_P(1))$. Then $0\to K\to H\to F\to0$, and the ideal of $P'$ in $P$ is $K\otimes\mathcal O_P(-1)$. The pullback on cohomology supported at $Z$ is injective by [lem-per-modified-blowup-generalized-class], with $E=H$ and $C=Z$.

Write $S_F(\xi)=\sum_{a=0}^{m-1}(-1)^ac_a(F)\xi^{m-1-a}$, so $Q_F=-S_F$. Let $G_P$ be the ideal-normalized pseudo-divisor operator for $P\subset\operatorname{Bl}_Z X$. By [lem-per-modified-blowup-generalized-class], $\pi^*\gamma_{ji}=G_P(Q_H)$. Expand the pulled-back ideal class of $j$ using the trivialized-line factorization of Step 4 and additivity in [lem-per-noetherian-supported-product-calculus]. Its two summands give
$$\pi^*(\gamma_i\cdot\gamma_j)=\alpha+\beta,\quad
\alpha=G_P(-\gamma_i|_P),\quad
\beta=-G_{\widetilde Y\subset B}G_{P'\subset\widetilde Y}(Q_F).$$
Here the minus is precisely $\gamma_j=-e(I,1)$ from Step 2; the class of $i$ on $\widetilde Y$ is $G_{P'}(Q_F)$ by its defining blowup characterization, without using composition. Transverse Cartier interchange in [lem-per-noetherian-supported-product-calculus] rewrites $\beta=G_P(-G_{P'\subset P}(Q_F))$.

The restriction formula in [lem-per-modified-blowup-generalized-class] gives $\gamma_i|_P=(-1)^mc_m(F)$ (pullbacks from $Z$ are suppressed). The ideal of $P'$ in $P$ is $K\otimes\mathcal O_P(-1)$, so its ordinary Chern class is $c_1(K)-\xi$, by [lem-per-noetherian-etale-chern-identities] and the line additivity of [lem-per-noetherian-supported-product-calculus]. Forgetting this support therefore gives
$$\alpha=G_P((-1)^{m+1}c_m(F)),\quad
\beta=G_P((c_1(K)-\xi)S_F(\xi)).$$
Whitney gives $c_a(H)=c_a(F)+c_1(K)c_{a-1}(F)$, with $c_{-1}=0$. Substitute into $Q_H$ and collect coefficients of $\xi$:
$$Q_H=(c_1(K)-\xi)S_F(\xi)+(-1)^{m+1}c_m(F).$$
Applying the additive operator $G_P$ proves $\pi^*\gamma_{ji}=\alpha+\beta$; injectivity from Step 4 proves composition for $n=1$.

For arbitrary $n>0$, blow up $Y$ in $X$, with exceptional $j':P\hookrightarrow B$ and inverse image $i':P'\hookrightarrow P$ of $Z$. By [lem-per-regular-flag-blowup-geometry], these have codimensions $1,m$, and the conormal surjections have kernels $K,K'$ of rank $n-1$ with $i'^*K=K'$. The supported pullback on $H_Z^{2(m+n)}(X,\Lambda(m+n))$ is injective by [lem-per-modified-blowup-generalized-class], now taking $E=N_{X/Y}$ and $C=Z$. Its base-change and excess formulas, and $c_{n-1}(K^\vee)=(-1)^{n-1}c_{n-1}(K)$ from [lem-per-noetherian-etale-chern-identities], yield
$$\pi^*\gamma_{ji}=c_{n-1}(K'^\vee)\gamma_{j'i'},\qquad \pi^*\gamma_j=c_{n-1}(K^\vee)\gamma_{j'}.$$
The projection $p:P\to Y$ is flat and pulls $N_{Y/Z}$ back to $N_{P/P'}$, so the base-change formula also gives $p^*\gamma_i=\gamma_{i'}$.

On a chart cut out by a regular sequence $t_1,\ldots,t_c$, the quotient by its first $k-1$ elements makes $t_k$ a nonzerodivisor, by [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Its next vanishing subscheme is therefore Cartier. Apply the just-proved composition successively to this flag, beginning with the identity at $k=0$. Step 2 identifies every factor with the specified supported Kummer map. The resulting flag composite equals the globally constructed $\gamma_{i,N}$. In particular any two regular-generator flags, including any reordered flag that is regular, give the same class; when discussing an arbitrary permutation, shrink near $Z$ so the permuted generators are regular. Thus no gluing or local-detection assertion about arbitrary derived morphisms is used to construct the global class.

For a flat base change of pairs, regularity and the codimension are preserved by [lem-per-regular-lci-geometric-calculus], and its conormal pulls back to the new conormal: flat tensor applied to $0\to I\to\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal O_Z\to0$ identifies the pulled ideal with the new ideal, and then its quotient by the square with $v_Z^*(I/I^2)$. The arbitrary-base-change formula of [lem-per-modified-blowup-generalized-class] therefore gives $v^*\gamma_{i,N}=\gamma_{i',N'}$. Open restriction is included; on a Cartier flag it also follows factor by factor from [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer]. The twist comparison is the specified one in [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback].

For a localization or strict localization use its affine ind-etale system of neighbourhoods. On the local and strict-local Noetherian schemes, [lem-per-ind-etale-closed-support-base-change] identifies the exceptional targets by the closed-counit mate and respects successive restrictions. Step 10 identifies the supported classes because these maps are flat. To read this as continuity, apply [lemma-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-continuity] to the pair and its open complement; [lem-amb-closed-support-hom] expresses support by their shifted cone. Filtered colimits of the two localization long exact sequences identify the supported groups as well. The constants and Tate lines pull back by [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], and every class considered is the pullback of the fixed finite-stage construction. This gives precisely the stated canonical continuity compatibility, not a compact-support adjoint for a non-finite-type localization map.

proof.text: For $N\geq n$, keep the same conormal and modified blowup. Coefficient reduction carries the defining polynomial $Q_{E,N}$ and its pseudo-divisor image $G_N(Q_{E,N})$ to $Q_{E,n}$ and $G_n(Q_{E,n})$ by [lem-per-noetherian-etale-chern-identities, lem-per-noetherian-supported-product-calculus]. The triangle and its maps in [lem-per-modified-blowup-generalized-class] are coefficient-natural. Both the reduction of $\gamma_{i,N}$ and $\gamma_{i,n}$ therefore pull back to the same element; its uniqueness (the supported injection) makes them equal. This proves reduction for supported classes directly, with no assertion that coefficient reduction commutes invertibly with $i^!$ on arbitrary complexes. Under adjunction it is equality using the canonical counit-defined comparison. The root map and the comparisons for all signed twists are [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]; for a negative twist take the dual of a rank-one line. When $N=n$ this is the identity, and successive power maps compose since their exponents multiply.
